description.en: The configuration ID. You can call the ListHttpIncomingResponseHeaderModificationRules operation to obtain the configuration ID.

description.zh: 修改响应头，支持添加、删除、修改三种操作方式。
description.en: The response header modifications. Three operation types are supported: add, delete, and modify.

description.zh:
操作方式。取值范围：

- add：添加。
- del：删除
- modify：变更。
description.en:
The operation type. Valid values:

- add: Add.
- del: Delete.
- modify: Modify.

description.zh:
值类型。取值范围：
- static：静态模式。
- dynamic：动态模式。
description.en:
The value type. Valid values:
- static: Static pattern.
- dynamic: Dynamic schema.

description.zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
- 匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
- 匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
description.en:
The rule content, which uses a conditional expression to match user requests. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration. There are two usage scenarios:
- Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
- Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, for example, (http.host eq \"video.example.com\").

description.zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：

- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
description.en:
The rule switch. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration. Valid values:

- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

description.zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。
description.en: The rule name. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration.

description.zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行。
description.en: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

title.zh: 更新修改HTTP入站响应头配置
title.en: Update HTTP incoming response header modification configuration

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa update-http-incoming-response-header-modification-rule --site-id 498607398028944 --config-id 352816096987136 --rule-name rule_example --rule-enable on --rule http.host_eq_video.example.com --response-header-modification Type=static Value=headerValue Operation=add Name=headerName --sequence 1 --region cn-hangzhou
